purpose: Exact section-level media placement, accessibility copy and cover branding for the 13-guide MyPets launch library.

global_rules.hero_covers: Cover/hero is not counted inside the 103 in-guide placements.
global_rules.brand_mark: All covers use the official round MyPets logo/medallion as a visible editorial seal; print/PDF may additionally use a low-opacity round watermark.
global_rules.captions: Captions explain why the visual matters; they should not merely repeat the alt text.
global_rules.alt_text: Alt text describes the informational content/function. Decorative brand textures must use empty alt in HTML.
global_rules.video_print_fallback: Render video title, publisher, QR/link target and the three 'watch for' points in print/PDF.
global_rules.original_visuals: Render as semantic HTML/SVG with text equivalents; never raster-only.
